author: Vox
description:
“The Court has been putting a thumb on the scale in favor of the Republican Party, but it hasn't been putting a boulder on the scale.”

Vox’s Ian Millhiser explains how, while the US is an “imperfect democracy,” it’s still a democracy that’s responsive to voters.

author: Vox
description:
JD Vance is heavily rumored to be Donald Trump's successor in 2028. His new memoir is one of the first windows into how he wants to be seen and what he wants people to think of him.

Vox's Christian Paz reads between the lines and finds a candidate whose Catholic faith and political record don't quite line up.
